description:
An environmental site assessment team needs to know which target chemicals can be detected by a Photoionization Detector (PID) with a standard 10.6 eV lamp. Use CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to look up the 'Ionization Energy' (or Ionization Potential) for the following six chemicals: Benzene, Methane, Carbon tetrachloride, Trichloroethylene, Chloroform, and Styrene.

For each chemical, determine if it is DETECTABLE (Ionization Energy <= 10.6 eV) or NOT DETECTABLE (Ionization Energy > 10.6 eV).

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/pid_assessment.txt' with the following format for each chemical:

Chemical: [Name]
CAS: [CAS Number from CAMEO]
Ionization Energy: [Value] eV
PID Detectable: [DETECTABLE or NOT DETECTABLE]

At the end of the file, include a SUMMARY section counting the total detectable and not detectable chemicals.
